consideredButRejected.reason: The shape drawing helper was private, so the standalone page could not reuse it until it was exported.

integrationFriction.detail: The helper was private; the renderer needed a small public drawing contract before Chronoflow could use the Mosslight renderer.

reuseEstimate.rationale: The source note establishes renderer reuse and the API friction, but does not inventory all feature capabilities supplied by existing modules.

Existing simulation dispatch, surge resolution, save normalization, runtime press-edge handling, and shared Mosslight frame paths supplied four of five integration capabilities; the staged group transition and its specific outcome labels were new.
